# dokploy_organization (Resource)

Manages a Dokploy organization. Organizations are the top-level grouping for projects and resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic organization
resource "dokploy_organization" "main" {
  name = "My Company"
}

# Organization with logo
resource "dokploy_organization" "with_logo" {
  name = "Acme Corp"
  logo = "https://example.com/logo.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the organization.

### Optional

- `logo` (String) The logo URL or base64 encoded image for the organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the organization.

## Import

Organizations can be imported using their ID:

```shell
terraform import dokploy_organization.example abc123-organization-id
```

Or using import blocks (Terraform 1.5+):

```hcl
import {
  to = dokploy_organization.example
  id = "abc123-organization-id"
}
```
